cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era inn — holds her keepsake at chest height; an indoor lap pool with lane ropes — swimming breaststroke; a quiet seaside tide pool bordered by smooth volcanic rock — catching a small white sunhat that has floated within reach after a light breeze; a sheltered picnic pavilion beside an ancient hillside plum orchard in clear spring daylight — laughing quietly after folding her plain white lunch napkin into a small bird; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — holds her keepsake at chest height; her living room with a deep sofa — standing; her private chamber in a Han-era residence — standing; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — standing; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a castle courtyard rose garden around a stone fountain — carries a pipa lute by its neck at her side; her living room with a deep sofa — lying on her front; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — standing; an archery range of targets on a green field — standing
